subject: product-consulting-harness
convergence: every dimension >= 8.0 AND convergence checklist complete
threshold_rationale: Client engagements target 9.0; harness APC starts with greenfield gaps (PR lifecycle, runtime routing, skills, self-benchmark, loop CLI). 8.0 requires end-to-end operable capability with only minor gaps, achievable in <=5 iterations without scope inflation. Critical failures and checklist prevent paper convergence.

dimensions.success: Small seam-clear harness; new APC surface justified; no duplicate control planes.

bands.lte5: Unjustified layers, duplicated state, or false architecture claims.
bands.6to8: Seams exist; <=2 unjustified elements; docs mostly match tree.
bands.9to10: Every new path justified; nothing removable without loss; docs match tree.

required_evidence: inventory or find listing excluding .git and client engagement runs

dimensions.success: Stranger runs harness from README + consult help; smoke green.

bands.lte5: help/status broken; missing clone-run path; smoke fails.
bands.6to8: Core commands listed; smoke passes; README gaps but runnable.
bands.9to10: README+help cover core and APC commands; cold-path verified.

dimensions.success: Detects coding runtime/provider and routes workers; honest failures.

bands.lte5: No detection; opaque failure on wrong runtime.
bands.6to8: Detection or routing table; alternate path documented; honest failures.
bands.9to10: Documented detection+routing; exercised in smoke or check.

required_evidence: detection command output or check id runtime-detect

dimensions.success: Create PR, review, authorized merge, post-merge validate with artifacts.

bands.lte5: No PR/merge/validate path; force-merge or mock URLs as evidence.
bands.6to8: PR create+review on real repo; merge gated; validate partial.

required_evidence: gh pr create (or harness wrapper) output / PR URL
gh pr checks or CI status
authorized non-force merge log or owner-gated denial record

dimensions.success: Per-iteration learning artifacts; MEMORY continues across runs.

bands.lte5: No schema; lessons only in chat; MEMORY stale.
bands.6to8: Schema + lessons file; MEMORY updated for >=1 lesson.
bands.9to10: Schema validated; every closed iter has lessons+org review; MEMORY links runs.

dimensions.success: Guided/Directive/Challenge/Override selectable and binding in the loop.

bands.6to8: Mode show/set works; Challenge/Override documented with example.
bands.9to10: Mode enforced in reports; Challenge refusal or Override risks recorded.

bands.6to8: All three exist; >=2 produce run artifacts.
bands.9to10: All three produce artifacts; documented; smoke/check covers invocation.

required_evidence: skill entrypoints for critique, benchmark, design-sprint

dimensions.success: Deterministic checks+smoke archive real evidence; no fake greens.

bands.lte5: Smoke red; mocked validation used for scores.
bands.6to8: Smoke green; harness checks/scripts exist; outputs archived.
bands.9to10: Check suite maps to contract objectives; transcripts per iter.

required_evidence: statement that validation ran real commands

dimensions.success: Inspect→…→Learn operable for harness evolution with phase artifacts.

bands.lte5: Loop only prose; phases skipped without record.
bands.6to8: Documented sequence; >=1 full iteration with phase artifacts.
bands.9to10: CLI/runner drives phases; stop conditions honor this contract.

required_evidence: scores, critique, diff summary, lessons, org self-review

dimensions.success: No secrets; no force-merge; freeze held; no self-scoring; escalations recorded.

bands.lte5: Secret leak, force-merge, mid-run contract edit, or self-scoring.
bands.6to8: Gates documented and mostly followed; freeze intact.
bands.9to10: Gates automated or checklist-complete; Critic safety verdict clean.

required_evidence: LOCK.md / empty git diff on contract files during run
non-force merge logs or auth gate record
Critic verdict: no secrets; scoring role separation

scoring_protocol.evaluator: Independent only; implementer must not score own work.
scoring_protocol.evidence_rule: Score without required evidence is void.
scoring_protocol.disputes: Lower score wins until new evidence.
scoring_protocol.overall: Mean of ten dimensions, one decimal; convergence is per-dimension.
scoring_protocol.baseline: iter-0 before APC-lifting changes; never re-scored retroactively.
scoring_protocol.freeze: Do not modify HARNESS-BENCHMARK-CONTRACT.md or contract.json during a run; proposals to proposed-benchmark-changes.md only.

convergence_checklist: lock files unmodified during converging run
real PR URL from harness-driven workflow
authorized merge demonstrated or owner-gated denial recorded
post-merge or post-PR validation artifact present
learning artifact present for converging iteration
no critical failures on converging iteration

critical_failures_detail.secrets-in-artifacts: API keys, tokens, private keys, or .env contents in state/, reports, or PR bodies.
critical_failures_detail.force-merge: gh pr merge --admin, force-push to main/master, or bypassing required checks without owner-written exception.
critical_failures_detail.benchmark-moved-mid-run: Content change to HARNESS-BENCHMARK-CONTRACT.md or contract.json during an active iteration.
critical_failures_detail.fake-or-mocked-validation: Fabricated outputs, stub PR URLs, or greens not from claimed command/repo.
critical_failures_detail.self-scoring: Implementer authored or overwrote scores.json without independent evaluator.
critical_failures_detail.missing-critic-verdict: Iteration closed without Critic audit of diff, scores, and org.
critical_failures_detail.unauthorized-destructive-action: Data loss, force reset, or scope change without owner escalation record.
critical_failures_detail.client-vision-rewrite: Changing client product vision to make scores easier.

invariants: Permanent workers: Principal, Analyst, Builder, Critic unless owner escalates.
Prefer deletion when scores would tie.
Does not amend client BENCHMARKS.md v1 mid-engagement.
